dialogues.speaker: "Achupalla"
dialogues.text: Oh, thank you for saving me... I never thought Achu would trap me...

dialogues.speaker: "Achupalla"
dialogues.text: It must have reached adolescence. Every time it sees red, it gets all excited.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I don't think it's got anything to do with adolescence...

dialogues.speaker: "Achupalla"
dialogues.text: Hmm? Is there some other reason?

dialogues.speaker: "Achupalla"
dialogues.text: How could there be anything strange at the resort... Oh!

dialogues.speaker: "Achupalla"
dialogues.text: Actually, yes! I saw two strange people around here recently. One was bald, and the other had an eyepatch.

dialogues.speaker: "Achupalla"
dialogues.text: I think they were fighting on the beach, and maybe Achu saw their blood... Huh, is that why red sets it off so much?

dialogues.speaker: "Achupalla"
dialogues.text: Hmm, something feels off. I need to report this to the higher-ups, and you take care too, yeah? If you see those two weirdos, turn the other way.
